confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate with no live price check. Food and coffee anchors are moderately solid. Accommodation is less certain because Hong Kong rates vary widely by district and date, and July is typically a softer hotel month, so those anchors lean toward the middle-to-lower range. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor. The FX value comes from search-result summaries attributed to RBA pages, not a direct page read; an RBA homepage snapshot for 14 October in the results showed 0.7002.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Loose benchmark against other high-cost Asian financial hubs, such as Singapore and Tokyo, for dining and hotel levels. The Hong Kong dollar is linked to the US dollar in a narrow band, so USD anchors are relatively stable.
